articles.summary: OnKure Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: OKUR) (“OnKure”), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the development of novel precision medicines in oncology, today announced the completion of its previously announced merger of OnKure, Inc. and Reneo Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
